kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Define the interfaces, material requirements and acceptance plan for your custom project.
intro.zh: 围绕定制项目定义接口、材料要求与验收方案。

jump.zh: 查看接口配置与材料选型

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: 经原厂资料核验的接口组件参考。

intro.en: Materials identified for the specific interface or molding process.
intro.zh: 用于具体接口或成型工艺选型的材料。

copy.en: Distinguish a wire-to-wire branch splice from a wire-to-terminal bond. Agree the validation standard for the actual joint.
copy.zh: 先区分线对线分支焊与线对端子焊，再约定实际接点适用的验证标准。

copy.en: List every wire material, cross-section, strand construction, surface condition and branch orientation. Treat a changed combination as a review trigger.
copy.zh: 列明每根导体材质、截面积、绞线结构、表面状态与分支方向；组合改变时重新审核。

copy.en: Define strip length, cleanliness, strand integrity and the allowed stack arrangement without assuming plated or lubricated wire behaves like bare conductor.
copy.zh: 定义剥线长度、清洁度、线股完整性及允许叠放方式，不能假定镀层或润滑线材与裸导体表现相同。

copy.en: Record the machine and tooling identity, force or pressure, amplitude, energy and monitoring limits developed for the actual joint.
copy.zh: 记录针对真实焊点开发的设备与工装身份、力或压力、振幅、能量及监控限值。

copy.en: Review nugget location, insulation clearance, strain relief and the selected protective system together with harness routing.
copy.zh: 结合线束走向审核焊点位置、绝缘间距、应力释放与所选防护体系。

copy.en: Agree mechanical strength, electrical resistance and environmental conditioning for the joint, with controlled sample preparation and traceable acceptance records.
copy.zh: 为焊点约定机械强度、电阻及环境条件试验，并控制制样方式与可追溯的验收记录。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: Project and manufacturer references are shown only at their audited counts. Process requirements are defined separately from finished-product ratings.
reason.zh: 项目与原厂编号仅按实际核验数量展示，工艺要求和成品等级分别定义。
